definitions.explanation: The time when the sky begins to lighten before sunrise; early morning twilight.
The early stages or beginning of something, especially a new era or movement.

examples.japanese: {曙|あけぼの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{差|さ}し{込|こ}む→差し込む：04235_sashikomu⟧。
examples.english: The light of dawn streams in.
In spring, the dawn is lovely.
examples.notes: Famous opening line from {枕草子|まくらのそうし} (The Pillow Book).

examples.japanese: {新時代|しんじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曙|あけぼの}。
examples.english: The dawn of a new era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曙|あけぼの}。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{曙|あけぼの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This discovery became the dawn of the scientific revolution.

notes:
{曙|あけぼの} is a poetic word for dawn.

LITERARY SIGNIFICANCE:
The word is famous from the opening of {枕草子|まくらのそうし} (The Pillow Book, ~1000 CE): ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{曙|あけぼの} ("In spring, the dawn...").

REGISTER:
Poetic and literary; for everyday use, ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧ or ⟦{明|あ}け{方|がた}→明け方：17595_akegata⟧ are more common.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{暁|あかつき}→暁：10036_akatsuki⟧: dawn (also literary)
- ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧: daybreak (more common)
- ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}→日の出：17596_hinode⟧: sunrise
